p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    """Draw 1-rays from boundary markers; recolor 2-components crossed by a ray."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rays = set()
    for c in range(w):
        if grid[0][c] == 1 or grid[h-1][c] == 1:
            rays.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    for r in range(h):
        if grid[r][0] == 1 or grid[r][w-1] == 1:
            rays.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    # Components of color 2 intersected by any ray become color 1 in entirety.
    seen = set()
    recolor = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while stack:
                x,y=stack.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                    if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and grid[nx][ny]==2 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nx,ny)); stack.append((nx,ny))
            if any(p in rays for p in comp):
                recolor.update(comp)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in rays: out[r][c]=1
    for r,c in recolor: out[r][c]=1
    return out
''')
